scope: Compile GBNF only; no model load/inference and no semantic result.

runs.label: default-library-path
argv:
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from importlib.metadata import version
from llama_cpp import LlamaGrammar,llama_supports_gpu_offload
protocol=json.loads(Path("evals/interaction/cycle-25/structured-provider-protocol.json").read_text())
rows=[]
for case in protocol["cases"]:
 grammar=LlamaGrammar.from_json_schema(json.dumps(case["schema"]),verbose=False)
 rows.append({"id":case["id"],"grammar_nonempty":bool(grammar._grammar),"grammar_sha256":hashlib.sha256(grammar._grammar.encode()).hexdigest(),"gbnf":grammar._grammar})
print(json.dumps({"llama_cpp_python":version("llama-cpp-python"),"cuda_offload_supported":llama_supports_gpu_offload(),"models_loaded":False,"schemas":rows},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
